policy: Thresholds are measured values minus a stated tolerance — never targets, never lowered to make a run pass.
The eval is deterministic, so a rerun reproduces the measurement exactly; the tolerance only leaves room for a deliberate trade-off, which must be explained in EVALUATION.md.
Financial fields (date, amount, description): aggregate -0.5 pt, per layout -1.0 pt, exact-row recall -0.5 pt.

Regression set: every financial field must be 100% (63 rows; one wrong row is a 1.6 pt drop, so any tolerance would hide a broken behaviour).
Dataset fingerprints pin the fixtures: editing an expected answer fails the gate until this file is re-recorded on purpose.
